fields.message: Your Google listing shows the business as open.
Your website says you close at 5pm on weekdays; your Google listing says 6pm.
fields.detail: openingHoursSpecification on https://northfieldplumbing.example/#plumber differs Mon–Fri closing time

fix.site: AJR Core → Business details → Opening hours
fix.google: Google Business Profile → Edit profile → Hours

fields.message: Your website does not link to your Google listing.

fix.site: AJR Core → Business details → Profiles elsewhere (or Google → Google reviews, "this is my business")

suggestions.why: Google's data shows your main category as the general "Services". A specific main category ("Plumber") is the strongest signal for which searches show your listing.
suggestions.where: Business Profile → Edit profile → Business category
suggestions.detail: Places primaryType "service" is generic; the site's schema type is Plumber. Check the profile's current primary category before changing it.

suggestions.why: Your Google listing says you close at 6pm on weekdays; your website says 5pm. Callers who get no answer after 5pm tend to leave poor reviews.
suggestions.detail: listing regularOpeningHours closes 18:00 Mon–Fri; https://northfieldplumbing.example/#plumber publishes 17:00. Confirm with the client which is right.

suggestions.why: Tagging the website link on your Google listing lets your report count the visits that come from the listing.
suggestions.where: Business Profile → Edit profile → Contact → Website
suggestions.detail: websiteUri has no utm_ parameters; GA4 files these visits under google / organic.

suggestions_unchecked.why: Your website takes online bookings. If your Google listing has no booking link, adding one lets people book straight from Google.
suggestions_unchecked.where: Business Profile → Edit profile → Contact → Booking links
suggestions_unchecked.detail: the site publishes a ReserveAction target /book-online/; Places does not expose the listing's booking link.
suggestions_unchecked.reason: Google's data doesn't show booking links, so we can't tell whether your listing has one.
Google's data doesn't show the towns your listing serves, so missing towns can't be checked.
hostile: a script URL as the booking link (same id as the real row: dropped twice over)
hostile: a line separator inside the link
